import_fragments.adopted_edition: PLOS Computational Biology publisher Version of Record PDF/complete HTML, 2019-04-09
import_fragments.source_scope: Publisher main VoR plus official raw-frozen S1 File; S1 closes flat/delta-rule comparator semantics, robustness, confidence and apparent-learning-rate analyses.

operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:coupled-change-point-posterior: A hierarchical learner tracks two transition probabilities and a shared higher-level change-point probability p_c.
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:cross-variable-confidence-reset: Evidence for a global change in one transition resets confidence for both coupled transition probabilities, including the unobserved one.
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:flat-leaky-beta-count: The flat comparator maintains beta-posterior counts with exponential forgetting (Methods Eqs.2-4), approximating delta-rule estimates without global change-point transfer.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: BLF-03 (Glaze et al. 2015) is directly cited in discussion of leaky integration/adaptive learning; the main source does not establish that the BLF-02 coupled-transition hierarchy is a direct mathematical descendant.

source_loci: BLF-02 main model source_loci and bounded_native_findings

adverse_source_limits: Flat leaky-beta counts are not unconditionally identical to a delta rule; persistent prior counts distinguish them, while zero-prior large-n yields asymptotic equivalence.
Flat and hierarchical first-order estimates can correlate strongly.
Task structure is instructed and only moderately identifiable from one subject's observations.
Whole ancestry remains non-exhaustive; source closure is not genealogy independence.

scientific_effect.supplement_mandatory_reason: Main article delegates model-comparison/adverse-detail closure to S1; W7 could not qualify the bounded profile without the raw source.
scientific_effect.variants: S1 confirms the flat leaky-beta comparator is delta-rule-like; exact asymptotic equivalence requires zero prior counts. It separately tests hierarchical vs flat confidence and apparent-learning-rate signatures.
scientific_effect.narrowed_statement: Do not equate the flat model unconditionally with a delta rule: persistent prior counts distinguish them; zero-prior large-n is the equivalence regime.

w8s_source_resolution.ancestry_handoff: BLF-02↔BLF-03 remains a downstream genealogy question; W8-S does not adjudicate independence.

operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:population-superposition-storage: Multiple simultaneously presented visual items are overlaid in a shared population activity state; the model is a restricted palimpsest and does not model indefinite sequential overwriting.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:noisy-population-state: The final memory population is a noisy combination of item-evoked population responses; representational precision depends on population code and noise.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:cue-conditioned-bayesian-recall: Given a cue to one feature, recall samples/infers the posterior for the target feature from the final noisy population state; apparent guessing arises from posterior uncertainty rather than a separate random-guess state.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:mixed-vs-hierarchical-code-varian: The source compares mixed/conjunctive and hierarchical population coding organizations and analyzes binding/fidelity consequences.

import_fragments.direct_ancestor_note: Population-coding and Bayesian-recall predecessors are discussed, but no single source-explicit paper-level DOI was frozen by W3 as a direct ancestor of the full palimpsest model.

source_loci: PLOS main model and Methods; Supporting Information declaration for additional derivations

adverse_source_limits: The model is deliberately simplified/exploratory and does not by itself establish a measured biological storage implementation.
The central store is an overlaid population representation; behavioral short-term-memory effects must not be relabeled as a generic computational storage operator.
Fisher-information/fidelity equivalence is approximation/assumption dependent.
Hierarchical-code recall saturation and mixed-code precision depend on conjunctivity, population size, feature count and receptive-field assumptions.

scientific_effect.supplement_mandatory_reason: S1 supplies mathematical derivations needed to close the main article's Fisher-information/fidelity claims and hierarchical-code analyses.
scientific_effect.variants: S1 extends hierarchical-code stimulus-separation analysis and relates conjunctivity to population size and number of feature dimensions.
scientific_effect.narrowed_statement: The Fisher-information/fidelity relation is approximation/assumption dependent; hierarchical-code performance can saturate with stimulus separation and depends on conjunctivity/population-size parameterization.

w8s_source_resolution.ancestry_handoff: Whole model ancestry remains NOT_ATTESTED; no new DOI-level direct ancestor is promoted.

import_fragments.source_scope: Publisher VoR main article plus official raw-frozen S1 Text, including Fisher-information/fidelity derivations and hierarchical/mixed-code scaling analyses.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:synergy-factorized-forward-map: The body-machine mapping C is factorized as W Phi using participant-derived motor synergies, providing a lower-dimensional learned representation of a high-dimensional motor mapping.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:perceptual-recency-dynamics: A continuous-feedback perception model filters recent joint-motion information before forward/inverse learning; this is an internal perceptual state, distinct from the externally imposed target task.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:forward-error-gradient-update: The forward mapping estimate is updated by gradient descent on a forward/sensory-prediction error with forward learning rate gamma.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:inverse-control-gradient-update-w: Nominal joint velocity is updated by gradient descent on a cost combining target/task error and control energy, with exploratory noise; the paper interprets this as de-novo controller acquisition rather than mere motor adaptation.

import_fragments.direct_ancestor_note: The source states that its forward/inverse formulation follows Pierella et al. 2019 and that removing the perception model and task-error regularization exactly recovers that episodic model; it also states the convention was originally introduced by Jordan & Rumelhart 1992.

source_loci: PLOS Model Eqs. 6-9; HML parameter discussion; explicit Pierella/Jordan-Rumelhart lineage; Supporting S1 declaration

adverse_source_limits: The model is a fitted/normative computational account; human behavioral trajectories do not directly measure forward-map or inverse-controller neural states.
The paper explicitly cautions that forward/inverse coevolution is well established in adaptation but generalization to de-novo skill learning requires care.
Motor synergies are a representation/factorization choice and must not be confused with the externally imposed target-capture task.

Exact exponential convergence is conditional: no inverse exploration noise, persistently exciting perceptual/motion input, sufficiently small γ²/(ηkP), and initialization in Ωc. With stochastic exploration noise, trajectories are stated to remain in an O(|σu|) neighborhood rather than converge exactly to zero.

scientific_effect.supplement_mandatory_reason: S1 contains the HML equations and the stability/convergence analysis expressly deferred from the main text.
scientific_effect.variants: Forward-map learning and inverse-control learning remain coupled on separated time scales; exploration noise is analyzed separately from the deterministic theorem.
scientific_effect.narrowed_statement: Exponential convergence is not unconditional: Theorem 1 assumes no inverse exploration noise, persistently exciting δq, sufficiently small γ²/(ηkP), and initial state inside Ωc. With stochastic exploration noise, the supplement states trajectories enter/stay in an O(|σu|) ball rather than converge exactly to the origin.

w8s_source_resolution.ancestry_handoff: Existing W3 direct-ancestor entries are retained; W8-S makes no independence claim.

import_fragments.source_scope: Publisher VoR main article plus official raw-frozen S1 mathematical supplement; HML model equations, conditional stability/convergence proof, and supplementary model investigations are source-qualified.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:last-success-aim-cache: The model retains a single intended aim associated with the most recent successful reach rather than a full action-value/reinforcement landscape representation.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:reinforcement-gated-aim-update: After success, intended aim moves by proportion alpha toward the successful reach; after failure, intended aim is retained rather than directly shifted.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:outcome-dependent-exploration-var: Trial movement variance combines motor/execution variance and an added exploratory component after unsuccessful outcomes.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:local-reinforcement-landscape-sam: Movement variability samples a spatially local region of the continuous action space; learning uses temporally recent local reward information and does not construct a global expected-value table.

import_fragments.direct_ancestor_note: The source says Pekny et al. 2015 provided motivation for outcome-dependent variability and that the resulting formulation is similar to Therrien et al. 2018, while explicitly distinguishing its aim-update rule. Haith & Krakauer 2014 is also named as a motivating MCMC model but the cited conference item has no source-pinned DOI, so no DOI is invented for it.

source_loci: PLOS Learning model Eq. 1 and best-fit parameter section; discussion of Haith/Krakauer, Pekny, Therrien lineage; Supporting S2/S3 Data declarations

adverse_source_limits: The model is explicitly phenomenological and local: it requires a non-zero reward gradient within the range of natural movement variability and is limited to small workspace regions.
It caches one successful aim and uses local exploration; it does not learn or store a full reinforcement landscape.
The modeled intended aim is latent and fitted from behavior, not a directly measured neural state.
S2 behavioral estimates of σm and σe are initial guesses; S3 final bootstrap optimization frees α, σm and σe. These data/fitting artifacts do not add a new core model operator.

scientific_effect.supplement_mandatory_reason: S2 and S3 close the parameter-estimation provenance chain used to initialize and fit the published learning model.
scientific_effect.variants: S2 estimates motor/exploratory variability from behavioral trial structure and uses them only as initial guesses; S3 fits the three free parameters α, σm, σe by two-step bootstrap optimization with all three free in the final step.
scientific_effect.narrowed_statement: S2/S3 are data/estimation artifacts, not mathematical model definitions. Final fitting frees σm and σe rather than fixing the S2 behavioral estimates.

w8s_source_resolution.ancestry_handoff: Existing direct-ancestor notes are retained; no new family-independence conclusion follows from fitted data.

import_fragments.source_scope: Publisher VoR main article plus official raw-frozen S2/S3 Data; behavioral variance estimates and two-step bootstrap optimization provenance are qualified without treating data files as model definitions.

Publisher main PDF plus all four official raw-frozen model-defining Text S1-S4; nonlinear transition approximation, forward/backward inference, augmented input inference and multimodal precision weighting are source-qualified.
import_fragments.computational_state: Continuous hidden state (allocentric location, speed, direction), control inputs, and modality-specific sensory observations in a nonlinear state-space generative model; environment-generated signals remain distinct from the agent observation model.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:state-transition-observation-mode: Separate transition and observation mappings define the state-space model; S4 makes explicit that path-integration and modality-specific sensory evidence are combined by relative precision/covariance weighting rather than by a separate policy operator.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:ekf-forward-filter: Gaussian/EKF-style forward filtering combines transition prediction and sensory correction, while S1 narrows the nonlinear implementation: simple Jacobian flow approximations were inaccurate, so F_n/H_n are estimated by local regression over multiple expansion points sampled from the previous posterior.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:rts-gamma-backward-smoother: General retrospective state inference uses online gamma recursions without storing the observation time series; the linear-dynamical specialization corresponds to the RTS smoother. Offline alpha-beta recursions remain a distinct alternative requiring stored observations.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:augmented-state-control-inference: Unknown control inputs are inferred via an augmented state-space model using forward/backward inference to obtain state trajectories and controls consistent with sensory goals.

unresolved_direct_ancestry: The source places the algorithms in the broad KF/EKF/RTS/state-space literature and cites earlier localisation/context models, but W4 does not collapse generic Bayesian/state-space machinery into a direct DOI model-family ancestry edge.

required_supplements_or_corrections.role: Text S2 general forward/backward density recursions
Text S3 augmented state-space inference over inputs
Text S4 relative precision of path integration and sensory cues

adverse_source_limits: Environment dynamics are not collapsed into the agent observation model.
Forward filtering, backward smoothing, observation mapping and control inference remain distinct operators.
Inferred controls are latent inputs recovered by augmented-state inference and are not silently promoted to a closed-loop policy layer.
The nonlinear implementation uses posterior-sampled local regression for flow matrices after simple Jacobian approximations were found inaccurate.
Gamma and offline alpha-beta backward formulations remain distinct variants; generic Bayesian/state-space terminology is not evidence of identity with another profile.

scientific_effect.supplement_mandatory_reason: Text S1-S4 supply the implementation details for nonlinear local linearization, general forward/backward recursions, augmented input inference, and cue-precision weighting required for full model definition.
scientific_effect.variants: S2 keeps gamma backward inference distinct from the offline alpha-beta alternative; S3 treats unknown controls via augmented-state inference; S4 parameterizes path-integration/sensory weighting by precision.
scientific_effect.narrowed_statement: For nonlinear dynamics, S1 reports simple Jacobian flow approximations were inaccurate and adopts posterior-sampled local regression to estimate F_n/H_n. Gamma recursions are the general online backward method; RTS is the linear-Gaussian specialization. Inferred controls are posterior latent inputs, not a new closed-loop policy operator.

w8s_source_resolution.ancestry_handoff: Generic state-space/KF/RTS or local-regression method references are not promoted to whole-model direct ancestry here.
